global: This is a bowl of clear, light-colored ramen broth, topped with bean sprouts, shredded carrot, and chopped green onions. It sits in a white bowl with red geometric patterns, on a dark wooden table under warm, even lighting.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and glossy finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and filled with tender noodles, bean sprouts, and garnishes.
